experiment: Qwen3-4B capacity control under unchanged original R0 reward

interpretation_rules.4B_GRPO_much_better_than_1.7B_R0: Supports model capacity as a meaningful contributor, but does not prove the reward is optimal.
interpretation_rules.4B_SFT_strong_but_GRPO_worse: Supports the GRPO reward/objective as a bottleneck.
interpretation_rules.4B_SFT_and_4B_GRPO_both_near_chance: Scaling alone is insufficient; redesigning supervision/reward is warranted.
interpretation_rules.4B_GRPO_improves_reward_but_not_outcome_: Suggests reward-objective misalignment: the model learns rewarded FIRAC properties without stronger outcome discrimination.
